brief: A continuous, visible trail of deep, high-contrast ink is laid down across the canvas whenever the cursor moves. This ink does not simply fade; instead, it accumulates and organizes into intricate, geometric, crystalline structures along the path of travel. These formations are governed by the speed of the cursor, and when the user moves quickly, the resulting crystalline edges flash with a momentary, shimmering metallic sheen. The entire system is reactive, with the drawing and transformation of the persistent ink structures directly controlled by the movement of the input cursor.
